clauses.clause: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: Tree = the compiler's B13-etb+if+B5a-draw-one parse. Trace: [cast] without an attack draws nothing (hand 6 -> 5), [enters during the opponent's turn] draws nothing (right); no variant attacks first. Packs (pass): storm_fleet_spy_raid_draws_after_attack - attack, then cast in the postcombat main: exactly one card drawn; storm_fleet_spy_no_draw_without_your_attack - no attacker declared, and an entry after the opponent attacked: no draw. Mutants without TURN_OF YOU or without the condition are killed.
